Subject: GCP Marketplace: entitlement & SKU mapping — procurement integration

Hi Lena / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move toward listing on GCP Marketplace and enabling co-sell, the next item both sides flagged was SKU entitlement mapping and the procurement handoff so your billing and SSO teams can consume the listing cleanly.

Attached is a draft SKU mapping template and a short procurement checklist that outlines the pieces GCP will expect for procurement flow (billing SKUs, entitlements, partner IDs). Can you confirm who on your side will own:
- confirmation of account entitlement mappings to your internal SKUs
- any invoicing/PO format constraints
- expected DocuSign signer for the reseller agreement

Proposed next steps:
1) Acme fills the left column of the SKU mapping csv with your internal SKU IDs by Tue 11/10.
2) Redwood reviews and proposes mapping rules and a fallback SKU for metered consumption.
3) We run a short integration test in staging before we request GCP listing activation.

I copied our product and listing leads (Karthik & Vanessa) to ensure technical and Ops alignment.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Director, Commercial GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sku_mapping_template.csv (CSV), procurement_requirements.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: entitlement & SKU mapping — procurement integration

Thanks Michael — quick technical notes from our side. A couple of clarifications that will help us avoid rework: 

1) Entitlement granularity: Are you mapping entitlements at customer account level (e.g., ACME-ENT-0001) or product-site level? The template assumes account-level entitlements; if you need product-level we should add an extra column (product_id).

2) Metering and fallback SKU: For burst workloads we suggest reserving a low-cost fallback SKU to avoid failed calls when a specific meter is missing. We can supply recommended pricing tiers for that SKU.

3) Invoice reference: GCP will surface a usage id in the billing export. Please confirm the PO/reference field you require so we can populate it in our billing metadata.

If Acme can confirm (1) entitlement granularity and (2) PO/reference format by Monday 11/09 EOD (your timezone), we will produce a mapped CSV and a short staging test plan by 11/12.

Onward,
Karthik
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
